reviews.text: The girl who trimmed my cat’s nails was incredibly kind, gentle, and patient. She made the whole experience so easy and stress-free, and I could tell she genuinely cares about animals. I’m so grateful for her kindness and professionalism. Highly recommend!
Kate is amazing and she is so sweet and patient with our dog! She takes her time with the grooming to make sure our pup is comfortable and does a great job. Highly recommend.

Kate is an amazing person who provides an amazing service. She genuinely cares for your dog. I highly recommend her without a doubt to any dog owner, especially for your puppy’s first grooming or if you have an anxious dog.
Thanks for accommodating my big anxious baby
Kate is the best!! The most kind and caring dog groomer I have ever met!! Coco runs in to see her.
The name says it all! Care for our canine by Kate was 5 stars service and results! Look at this dude!

I've been bringing my dog to Kate's grooming for a year now and I couldn't be happier! Kate has a bubbly presence, she takes her time to answer your questions and genuinely cares about the dogs. My dog get anxious going to the groomer, what I like about bringing him to Kate, is that she might only have 1 other dog while my dog is there. She gives him treats and approaches him gently. Her prices are reasonable as well!!
Kate is so sweet! Always so happy with the grooming she does on my maltese, she always takes the time to make sure everything looks perfect.

We had a great experience getting our dog Annie groomed by Kate. She took the time to make our nervous dog feel comfortable and clearly places a high priority on the dog’s wellbeing. After Annie had a negative experience with our previous groomer, we were so relieved to find Kate. And the cut was great, too!

Perfect service. The groomer who took care of our plushies doggo loves dogs and her job. And it shows!

Our doggy exhibited no symptoms of anxiety coming out of grooming, which is a first for him.
Extremely kind, generous and helpful! Great vibes and a very good experience here.

Our dog has always been extremely anxious during grooming, and we have tried many different groomers over the years.  But from the very first visit, Kate showed so much patience, compassion, and understanding. She took the time to let my pup get comfortable, never rushed the process, and always prioritized her well-being over anything else.
If you have a nervous or sensitive dog, this is the place to go. Thank you for the incredible care and kindness you show every single time. You've truly made a difference!

Kate Is so caring and thoughtful, our furry companion is excited the moment he enters the salon, she created a lovely Space for dogs so they feel like home and cherry on the pie, her prices are competitive.

Kate provides such amazing care for our furry family member! She’s patient, experienced, and full of helpful tips for pet owners. I also find that she’s vetted a lot of the doggie playthings that she carries in her shop, so your K9 cuddle buddy will come home happy!

Kate is a fantastic person who truly loves what she does, with a passion and love for dogs. The extra care and effort are shown in the results of the grooming services she offers. She makes you and your dog feel right at home, providing a loving, safe, and fun environment for dogs to be pampered and cared for until you pick them up after she has finished Grooming. She makes you feel like a friend and not a client. Most importantly, she treats your dog as her own, which is crucial with Grooming. Kate is highly talented and caterers to her clients and furry friends.
Kat is nothing less than the dog whisperer! We are extremely grateful for her attention to detail and care for our Zeus. He absolute adores her.

Kate is the best with dogs ! She has taken care of my schnoodle girl for years. Before she started to grooming, we tried many places and she is really the best . Grooming is very stressing situation for dogs, but not with Kate. I recommend her 100%.
Kate is so caring- gave my anxious 5lb terrier an amazing spring do! He was so happy when i picked him up- thank you Kate! Love your kind es and attention

Kate is really great with my dog. My dog is pretty anxious/nervous when it comes to grooming, specifically the bath. She’s able to minimize his stress, ensure his comfort and he looks great afterwards!
Kind and gentle, my dog loves Kate!

Kate is truly wonderful with dogs! She has taken care of my boxer girl for years. Not only does she love all dogs but she is very responsible in terms of following safety and health regulations. I heartily recommend her!
